G2200.def: from «2204»; boiled, i.e. (by implication) calid (figuratively, fervent):--hot.

G2201.def: from the same as «2218»; a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together):--yoke, pair.

G2202.et: from a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as (2218)
G2202.def: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as «2218»; a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.

G2203.def: of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name Dis deece, which is otherwise obsolete Zeus or Dis (among the Latins, Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of the Greeks:--Jupiter.

G2204.def: a primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest):--be fervent.

G2205.def: from «2204»; properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice):--emulation, envy(-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.

G2206.def: from «2205»; to have warmth of feeling for or against:--affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous(-ly affect).

G2208.def: the same as «2208»; a Zealot, i.e. (specially) partisan for Jewish political independence:--Zelotes.

G2209.et: probably akin to the base of (1150) (through the idea of violence)
G2209.def: probably akin to the base of «1150» (through the idea of violence); detriment:--damage, loss.

G2210.def: from «2209»; to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment:--be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.

G2211.et: probably contracted from a poetic form of (2203) and (1435)
G2211.def: probably contracted from a poetic form of «2203» and «1435»; Jove-given; Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.

G2212.def: of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare «4441».

G2213.def: from «2212»; a search (properly concretely), i.e. (in words) a debate:--question.

G2214.def: from «2212»; a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme:--question.

G2215.def: of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain:--tares.

G2216.def: of Hebrew origin («02216»); Zorobabel (i.e. Zerubbabel), an Israelite:--Zorobabel.

G2217.def: akin to the base of «3509»; gloom (as shrouding like a cloud):--blackness, darkness, mist.

G2218.et: from the root of zeugnumi (to join, especially by a "yoke")
G2218.def: from the root of zeugnumi (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales):--pair of balances, yoke.

G2219.def: probably from «2204»; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.

G2221.def: from the same as «2226» and «64»; to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare:--take captive, catch.

G2223.et: probably akin to the base of (2218)
G2223.def: probably akin to the base of «2218»; a belt; by implication, a pocket:--girdle, purse.

G2224.def: from «2223»; to bind about (especially with a belt):--gird.

G2225.et: from the same as (2226) and a derivative of (1096)
G2225.def: from the same as «2226» and a derivative of «1096»; to engender alive, i.e. (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death:--live, preserve.

G2226.def: neuter of a derivative of «2198»; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.

G2227.def: from the same as «2226» and «4160»; to (re-)vitalize (literally or figuratively):--make alive, give life, quicken.

G2228.et: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms
G2228.def: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either, except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially «2235», «2260», «2273».

G2229.et: an adverb of confirmation, perhaps intensive of (2228)
G2229.def: an adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of «2228»; used only (in the New Testament) before «3303»; assuredly:--surely.

G2230.def: from «2232»; to act as ruler:--be governor.

G2231.def: from «2232»; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.

G2232.def: from «2233»; a leader, i.e. chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province:--governor, prince, ruler.

G2233.et: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of (71)
G2233.def: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of «71»; to lead, i.e. command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e. consider:--account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think.

G2234.et: from a derivative of the base of (2237)
G2234.def: adverb from a derivative of the base of «2237»; sweetly, i.e. (figuratively) with pleasure:--gladly.

G2235.def: apparently from «2228» (or possibly «2229») and «1211»; even now:--already, (even) now (already), by this time.

G2236.et: plural of the superlative of the same as (2234)
G2236.def: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as «2234»; with great pleasure:--most (very) gladly.

G2237.def: from handano (to please); sensual delight; by implication, desire:--lust, pleasure.

G2238.et: from the compound of the same as (2234) and (3744)
G2238.def: neuter of the compound of the same as «2234» and «3744»; a sweet-scented plant, i.e. mint:--mint.

G2239.def: a strengthened form of «1485»; usage, i.e. (plural) moral habits:--manners.

G2240.def: a primary verb; to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or figuratively):--come.

G2241.et: of Hebrew origin, (0410) with pronominal suffix
G2241.def: of Hebrew origin (410 with pronominal suffix); my God:-- Eli.

G2242.def: of Hebrew origin («05941»); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli.

G2243.def: of Hebrew origin («0452»); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.

G2244.def: from the same as «2245»; maturity (in years or size):--age, stature.

G2245.et: from helix (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age)
G2245.def: from helix (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age); as big as, i.e. (interjectively) how much:--how (what) great.

G2246.et: from hele (a ray, perhaps akin to the alternate of (138))
G2246.def: from hele (a ray; perhaps akin to the alternate of «138»); the sun; by implication, light:--+ east, sun.

G2247.def: of uncertain affinity; a stud, i.e. spike:--nail.

G2248.def: accusative case plural of «1473»; us:--our, us, we.

G2249.def: nominative plural of «1473»; we (only used when emphatic):--us, we (ourselves).

G2250.et: from (with (5610) implied) of a derivative of hemai (to sit, akin to the base of (1476)) meaning tame, i.e. gentle
G2250.def: feminine (with «5610» implied) of a derivative of hemai (to sit; akin to the base of «1476») meaning tame, i.e. gentle; day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context):--age, + alway, (mid-)day (by day, (-ly)), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years.

G2251.def: from «2349»; our:--our, your (by a different reading).

G2252.def: a prolonged form of «2358»; I was:--be, was. (Sometimes unexpressed).

G2253.et: from a presumed compound of the base of (2255) and (2348)
G2253.def: from a presumed compound of the base of «2255» and «2348»; half dead, i.e. entirely exhausted:--half dead.

G2254.def: dative case plural of «1473»; to (or for, with, by) us:--our, (for) us, we.

G2255.et: neuter of a derivative from an inseparable pref. akin to (260) (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-
G2255.def: neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to «260» (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-; (as noun) half:--half.

G2256.def: from the base of «2255» and «5610»; a half-hour:--half an hour.

G2257.def: genitive case plural of «1473»; of (or from) us:--our (company), us, we.

G2258.def: imperfect of «1510»; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were):--+ agree, be, × have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.

G2259.pos:
1. at which time, when
  2. whenever, at length when
G2259.def: of uncertain affinity; at which time:--when.

G2260.def: from «2228» and «4007»; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.

G2261.def: probably from «2031»; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.

G2262.def: of Hebrew origin («06147»); Er, an Israelite:--Er.

G2263.et: perhaps by transposition from (2048) (through the idea of stillness)
G2263.def: perhaps by transposition from «2048» (through the idea of stillness); tranquil:--quiet.

G2264.def: compound of heros (a "hero") and «1491»; heroic; Herod, the name of four Jewish kings:--Herod.

G2265.def: plural of a derivative of «2264»; Herodians, i.e. partisans of Herod:--Herodians.

G2266.def: from «2264»; Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family:--Herodias.

G2268.def: of Hebrew origin («03470»); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an Israelite:--Esaias.

G2269.def: of Hebrew origin («06215»); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.

G2270.def: from the same as «2272»; to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech:--cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest.

G2271.def: feminine of «2272»; (as noun) stillness, i.e. desistance from bustle or language:--quietness, silence.

G2272.et: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of (1476) and perhaps (2192)
G2272.def: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of «1476» and perhaps «2192»; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.

G2274.def: from the same as «2276»; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.

G2275.def: from «2274»; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.

G2276.et: neuter of comparative of heka (slightly) used for that of (2556)
G2276.def: neuter of comparative of heka (slightly) used for that of «2556»; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.

G2277.def: third person singular imperative of «1510»; let him (or it) be:--let ... be.

G2278.def: from «2279»; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.

G2279.def: of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.

G2280.def: of uncertain origin; Thaddaeus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddaeus.

G2281.def: probably prolonged from «251»; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.

G2282.def: probably akin to thallo (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.

G2283.def: of Hebrew origin («08559»); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.

G2284.def: from «2285»; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.

G2285.et: akin to an obsolete tapho (to dumbfound)
G2285.def: akin to an obsolete tapho (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.

G2287.def: from (the feminine form of) «2288» and «5342»; death-bearing, i.e. fatal:--deadly.

G2288.def: from «2348»; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively):--X deadly, (be...) death.

G2289.def: from «2288» to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.

G2290.def: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.

G2291.def: of Hebrew origin («08646»); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.

G2292.def: another form for «2293»; to exercise courage:--be bold, × boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare «5111».

G2293.def: from «2294»; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare «2292».

G2295.def: apparently from a form of «2300»; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.

G2296.def: from «2295»; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.

G2297.def: from «2295»; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful thing.

G2298.def: from «2296»; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).
